raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- On ROCm with `--attention-backend aiter`, the DSpark draft worker never gets aiter: `aiter` is not in `DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CHOICES`, so the draft falls back to triton.
- DFlash/DSpark draft layers are `ENCODER_ONLY` (each draft block attends to its prefix and to all of its own tokens). Triton runs that non-causal verify through `extend_attention_fwd`, which has no split-KV, so each draft layer reads a long prefix on a few CUs.
- Cost: for the Kimi-K3 draft at TP8 (8 Q / 2 KV heads, head dim 64, 4 draft tokens) one call takes 11.7 ms at 350K tokens of context.
- Bug: the aiter backend ignored `ENCODER_ONLY` in target verify and always ran causally.
- ROCm/aiter#7244 (stacked on ROCm/aiter#7088) lets AITER's Triton `unified_attention` take `causal=False`. This PR uses it for the DSpark MHA draft and fixes the aiter verify path. With an AITER that lacks it, nothing changes.

## Modifications

- `aiter_backend.py`, target verify:
  - An `ENCODER_ONLY` layer passes `causal=False` to `unified_attention` and to the legacy `extend_attention_fwd`, as triton does.
  - `ENCODER_ONLY` layers stay off `unified_attention_3d_mtp` (causal-only).
  - Under CUDA graphs the legacy path drops the custom mask when `spec_info` has none, as triton does.
  - CUDA-graph verify metadata fills the flat per-token `kv_indices` only for MLA and the legacy verify; unified verify reads the page table.
- `aiter_backend.py`: a DSpark draft runner (non-MLA, non-SHUFFLE-5D pool) uses `unified_attention` when `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` is unset.
- `draft_worker_common.py`: `resolve_draft_worker_attention_backend` keeps `aiter` for a DSpark draft only under the conditions below; otherwise it falls back as before.
- `dspark_config.py`: `draft_is_mla()` and `draft_has_sliding_window()` read the (MiniMax-translated) draft config.
- `utils/aiter.py`: `aiter_unified_attention_supports_non_causal()` checks that both Triton `unified_attention` kernels have the `CAUSAL` constexpr from ROCm/aiter#7244.

| Draft stays on `aiter` only when | Otherwise |
|---|---|
| Speculative algorithm is DSpark | fallback (triton) |
| AITER `unified_attention` accepts `causal=False` | fallback |
| Draft is not MLA (aiter MLA verify is causal-only) | fallback |
| Draft has no sliding-window layer (AITER rejects `causal=False` with a window) | fallback |
| `SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=nhd`, no unified memory | fallback |
| `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` not set to `0`, `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY` not `0` | fallback |
| Deterministic inference is off (aiter rejects `unified_attention` under it) | fallback |

| Env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` | unset (was `false`) | Unset: only a DSpark MHA draft on aiter uses `unified_attention`. Set: decides for every runner. |
| `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY` | `true` | Now read through `envs`; `0` also keeps the DSpark draft off aiter. |

## Accuracy Tests

Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8, TP8 + DSpark (block 4), 8x MI355X, AgentX c16 with real acceptance. Both trees are identical except for this PR's commits and ROCm/aiter#7244.

| | A: triton draft | B: aiter draft |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K (sgl-eval 0.1.3, 1319 questions) | 94.92% | 95.15% |
| Accept length at 13-16 running requests | 3.572 | 3.569 |

- The unchanged accept length shows the draft attention is still bidirectional; the pre-fix aiter path ran it causally.

Unit tests:

| Test | Device | Checks |
|---|---|---|
| `test/registered/attention/test_aiter_encoder_only_verify.py` | MI355X | `ENCODER_ONLY` and causal layers through aiter target verify vs a torch reference; 2D, split-KV and `unified_attention_3d_mtp` shapes; bf16 and fp8 KV. Fails before the fix and if the 3d_mtp gate is removed. Causal cases also run on an AITER without `causal=False`. |
| `test/registered/unit/spec/test_draft_worker_attention_backend.py` | CPU | DSpark draft keeps aiter; falls back for each condition in the table above, and for DFlash. |
| `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_aiter_verify_metadata.py` | CPU | Only a DSpark MHA draft on a 4D pool turns unified attention on by default. |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same A/B, 900 s, HiCache 220 GB, one run each (runs of this recipe spread by about 4%):

| | A: triton draft | B: aiter draft | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s/GPU | 5707.87 | 6251.76 | +9.5% |
| P90 ITL (ms) | 30.06 | 26.93 | -10.4% |
| P90 interactivity (1/s) | 33.27 | 37.13 | +11.6% |
| P90 TTFT (ms) | 1464.56 | 1705.96 | +16.5% |
| Requests | 383 | 397 | |

Draft verify kernel, one MI355X, 8 Q / 2 KV heads, head dim 64, bf16 Q, fp8 KV, page 128, 4 query tokens. Median of 20 calls, each after an L2/MALL eviction. Outputs match to 1e-4.

| Batch | triton `extend_attention_fwd`, non-causal (us) | AITER `unified_attention`, non-causal (us) |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 x 350K | 11750 | 55.6 |
| 4 x 350K | 11690 | 133.4 |
| 16 x 120K | 4118 | 165.0 |
| 32 x 120K | 4114 | 276.2 |
| 56 x 120K | 5586 | 430.8 |
| 56 x 30K | 1366 | 153.6 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""AITER target verify honors ENCODER_ONLY (bidirectional) attention layers."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.radix_attention import AttentionType
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.router import PlainPoolRouter
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_mode import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+_NON_CAUSAL = False
+if is_hip():
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import fp8_dtype
+    from sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_backend import AiterAttnBackend
+    from sglang.srt.utils.aiter import aiter_unified_attention_supports_non_causal
+
+    _NON_CAUSAL = aiter_unified_attention_supports_non_causal()
+
+_DRAFT_NUM = 4
+_PAGE_SIZE = 16
+# (prefix lengths, query heads, kv heads, head dim)
+_SHAPES = {
+    # Kimi-K3 DSpark draft at TP8; a short prefix takes the 2D kernel
+    "dspark_short": ((37, 300), 8, 2, 64),
+    # past 512 keys the verify takes the split-KV 3D kernel
+    "dspark_long": ((37, 3000), 8, 2, 64),
+    # the causal-only unified_attention_3d_mtp shape (GQA 16, head dim 256)
+    "mtp_shape": ((600, 1500), 32, 2, 256),
+}
+
+
+class _FakeKVPool:
+    def __init__(self, k_cache, v_cache):
+        self.k_cache = k_cache
+        self.v_cache = v_cache
+        self.start_layer = 0
+        self.layer_num = 1
+        self.layer_transfer_counter = None
+        self.layer_router = PlainPoolRouter(self, "full")
+
+    def get_kv_buffer(self, _layer_id):
+        return self.k_cache, self.v_cache
+
+
+def _reference(q, keys, values, prefix_lens, scaling, causal):
+    """Each request's block attends to its prefix and its own block; causal masks
+    the block's tail."""
+    num_q_heads, num_kv_heads = q.shape[1], keys[0].shape[1]
+    group = num_q_heads // num_kv_heads
+    out = []
+    for i, prefix_len in enumerate(prefix_lens):
+        rows = slice(i * _DRAFT_NUM, (i + 1) * _DRAFT_NUM)
+        k = keys[i].float().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        v = values[i].float().repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        scores = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", q[rows].float(), k) * scaling
+        if causal:
+            visible = torch.ones(
+                _DRAFT_NUM, prefix_len + _DRAFT_NUM, dtype=torch.bool, device=q.device
+            ).tril(diagonal=prefix_len)
+            scores = scores.masked_fill(~visible, float("-inf"))
+        out.append(torch.einsum("hqk,khd->qhd", scores.softmax(dim=-1), v))
+    return torch.cat(out)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_hip(), "requires HIP")
+class TestAiterEncoderOnlyTargetVerify(CustomTestCase):
+    def _run_verify(self, *, shape, attn_type, kv_dtype):
+        prefix_lens, num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim = shape
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        device = "cuda"
+        bs = len(prefix_lens)
+        seq_lens = [n + _DRAFT_NUM for n in prefix_lens]
+        pages_per_seq = -(-max(seq_lens) // _PAGE_SIZE)
+
+        k_cache = torch.zeros(
+            bs * pages_per_seq,
+            _PAGE_SIZE,
+            num_kv_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            dtype=kv_dtype,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        v_cache = torch.zeros_like(k_cache)
+        keys, values = [], []
+        for i, seq_len in enumerate(seq_lens):
+            # The verify block's K/V sit in the cache already, as the write
+            # before attention leaves them.
+            k, v = (
+                torch.randn(
+                    seq_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+                ).to(kv_dtype)
+                for _ in range(2)
+            )
+            k_cache.view(bs, -1, num_kv_heads, head_dim)[i, :seq_len] = k
+            v_cache.view(bs, -1, num_kv_heads, head_dim)[i, :seq_len] = v
+            keys.append(k)
+            values.append(v)
+        q = torch.randn(
+            bs * _DRAFT_NUM, num_q_heads, head_dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+        )
+
+        backend = object.__new__(AiterAttnBackend)
+        backend.use_mla = False
+        backend._use_unified_verify = True
+        backend.kv_cache_dtype = kv_dtype
+        backend.page_size = _PAGE_SIZE
+        unit_scale = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        backend.k_scale = backend.v_scale = unit_scale
+        backend.token_to_kv_pool = _FakeKVPool(k_cache, v_cache)
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_indices=torch.arange(
+                bs * pages_per_seq, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            ).view(bs, pages_per_seq),
+            swa_page_table=None,
+            qo_indptr=torch.arange(
+                0, bs * _DRAFT_NUM + 1, _DRAFT_NUM, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            ),
+            max_q_len=_DRAFT_NUM,
+            verify_seqused_k=None,
+        )
+        scaling = head_dim**-0.5
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_id=0,
+            attn_type=attn_type,
+            is_cross_attention=False,
+            sliding_window_size=None,
+            tp_q_head_num=num_q_heads,
+            tp_k_head_num=num_kv_heads,
+            tp_v_head_num=num_kv_heads,
+            qk_head_dim=head_dim,
+            v_head_dim=head_dim,
+            k_scale=None,
+            v_scale=None,
+            scaling=scaling,
+            logit_cap=0.0,
+        )
+        forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            attn_attend_prefix_cache=False,
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY,
+            out_cache_loc=None,
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor(prefix_lens, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
+        )
+        out = backend.forward_extend(
+            q, None, None, layer, forward_batch, save_kv_cache=False
+        ).view(-1, num_q_heads, head_dim)
+        return out, _reference(
+            q,
+            keys,
+            values,
+            prefix_lens,
+            scaling,
+            causal=attn_type != AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY,
+        )
+
+    def test_encoder_only_verify_is_bidirectional_within_the_block(self):
+        """An ENCODER_ONLY draft (DSpark) must see its whole block from every row,
+        on the 2D and split-KV kernels and on the shape the causal-only
+        unified_attention_3d_mtp serves; the backend used to mask the block."""
+        for name, shape in _SHAPES.items():
+            kv_dtypes = (
+                (fp8_dtype,) if name == "mtp_shape" else (torch.bfloat16, fp8_dtype)
+            )
+            for kv_dtype in kv_dtypes:
+                # ENCODER_ONLY needs an AITER unified_attention that takes causal=False.
+                attn_types = (AttentionType.DECODER,) + (
+                    (AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY,) if _NON_CAUSAL else ()
+                )
+                for attn_type in attn_types:
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        shape=name, kv_dtype=kv_dtype, attn_type=attn_type.name
+                    ):
+                        out, expected = self._run_verify(
+                            shape=shape, attn_type=attn_type, kv_dtype=kv_dtype
+                        )
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(
+                            out.float(), expected, atol=3e-2, rtol=3e-2
+                        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Which attention backend a draft worker gets from the published spec."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.speculative import draft_worker_common
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDraftWorkerAttentionBackend(CustomTestCase):
+    def _resolve(
+        self,
+        *,
+        algorithm,
+        aiter_non_causal=True,
+        draft_is_mla=False,
+        draft_has_sliding_window=False,
+        layout="nhd",
+        unified_attn=None,
+        unified_verify=True,
+        deterministic=False,
+    ):
+        spec = SimpleNamespace(
+            speculative_algorithm=algorithm, speculative_draft_attention_backend=None
+        )
+        memory = SimpleNamespace(enable_unified_memory=False)
+        exec_bag = SimpleNamespace(
+            deterministic=SimpleNamespace(enable_deterministic_inference=deterministic)
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(draft_worker_common, "get_spec", return_value=spec),
+            patch.object(draft_worker_common, "get_memory", return_value=memory),
+            patch.object(draft_worker_common, "get_exec", return_value=exec_bag),
+            patch.object(
+                draft_worker_common,
+                "attention_backends",
+                return_value=("aiter", "aiter"),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.utils.aiter.aiter_unified_attention_supports_non_causal",
+                return_value=aiter_non_causal,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_config.draft_is_mla",
+                return_value=draft_is_mla,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_config."
+                "draft_has_sliding_window",
+                return_value=draft_has_sliding_window,
+            ),
+            envs.SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.override(layout),
+            envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN.override(unified_attn),
+            envs.SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY.override(unified_verify),
+        ):
+            return draft_worker_common.resolve_draft_worker_attention_backend()
+
+    def test_aiter_serves_only_a_dspark_mha_draft_on_a_non_causal_aiter(self):
+        """A DSpark draft verifies its block bidirectionally. An AITER without
+        causal=False, the causal-only aiter MLA verify, a sliding-window draft, a
+        SHUFFLE 5D pool, unified attention or verify switched off, deterministic
+        inference, and DFLASH must all leave the draft on the fallback."""
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(algorithm="DSPARK"), "aiter")
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(algorithm="DSPARK", unified_attn=True), "aiter")
+        for case in (
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", aiter_non_causal=False),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", draft_is_mla=True),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", draft_has_sliding_window=True),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", layout="shuffle"),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", unified_attn=False),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", unified_verify=False),
+            dict(algorithm="DSPARK", deterministic=True),
+            dict(algorithm="DFLASH"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(**case):
+                self.assertNotEqual(self._resolve(**case), "aiter")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
